title: An easy API change can conceal a difficult behavioural change
text: The supplied analysis explains that model choice and agent-environment choice are different decisions. Provider-specific behaviour and integration assumptions can remain even behind a common interface. The organisation should test the complete replacement configuration, not infer portability from the connection code alone.
qualification: Corpus analysis of the article’s implications; no benchmark of migration effort is provided.
